sources.entry: PrestaShop - Fully scalable e-commerce solution. (Demo, Source Code) OSL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: PrestaShop is an open source PHP e-commerce web application for running online shops, with source code in this repo intended for development and preview.
summary.what_it_does: PrestaShop is an open source e-commerce web application written in PHP, aimed at both merchants and shoppers. The README says it is highly customizable, supports many payment services, is translated into many languages and localized for many countries, and has a responsive design for both front and back office. This repository holds the source code, which the README says is intended for development and preview only. For a production shop, the README directs users to the releases page for the latest stable public version (9.0 at the time of the README). Extensibility is through modules and themes, and developers can override default components and behaviors. The README also mentions a Docker-based development environment started with `make docker-start`, which serves the shop on port 8001 by default. Translation work is handled through Crowdin.
use_cases: set up a local PrestaShop development environment
translate an e-commerce platform via Crowdin
accept payments through third-party payment services
how_to_run: Clone this repository, then follow the development install guide linked in the README (installing PrestaShop for development).
Alternatively, run `make docker-start` for the Docker development environment.
Access the frontend and backoffice at the URLs provided by the Docker setup; the default port is 8001.
Log in with the default demo admin credentials (demo@prestashop.com / Pr3st4Sh0P) or set ADMIN_MAIL and ADMIN_PASSWD before running docker compose up.
For a production shop, download the latest release from the releases page instead of this source repository.
Server requirements for 9.0: PHP 8.1+ and MySQL 5.6+ (or MariaDB, Percona Server); Apache or Nginx recommended.
notable: Dedicated Docker-based development environment started with a single make command
Modules and themes extension system, with overrides of default components allowed
Translation managed through Crowdin and localized for many countries
Develop branch holds work in progress for the next version (9.1)
caveats: This source repository is intended for development and preview only; production users are directed to the releases page.
Requires PHP 8.1+ and a MySQL-compatible database, plus a web server such as Apache or Nginx.
The develop branch is work in progress for version 9.1 and is not a stable release.
